label: Air temperature at 50 hPa, about 20 km up (AIRS)
verdict: Air temperature at 50 hPa, about 20 km up (AIRS) (all months, 2003-2025): the trend is -0.01 degC per decade, about -0.02 degC over the whole period. It is NOT statistically significant: p = 0.816 >= 0.05. That does not prove there is no trend; the change is not distinguishable from year-to-year variability with this many years. A longer record or a larger region can make a real trend significant.

dataset.label: Air temperature at 50 hPa, about 20 km up (AIRS)
dataset.source: AIRS/Aqua L3 monthly standard retrieval v7, 1 deg (daytime pass)
dataset.note: Stratosphere: greenhouse gases warm the lower atmosphere and COOL this layer
